note: make rebaseline does NOT cover every committed golden. There are TWO regeneration paths and the root CLAUDE.md only documents one. scripts/regenerate-artifacts.sh (which make rebaseline calls) covers book/src/gallery, book/src/reference, book/src/laboratory, docs/audits, docs/digest, book/src/domesday and clients/game/core/tests/fixtures. It does NOT cover windows/vessel/tests/fixtures/*.json, which is a separate byte-golden set driven by REBASELINE=1 and refreshed with make rebaseline-goldens. Found the hard way during The Grain: an additive scene change regenerated cleanly under make rebaseline, and then make gate failed on two vessel golden tests that the rebaseline had never touched. So the sequence after any change to emitted scene or session JSON is make rebaseline THEN make rebaseline-goldens, and the git diff --exit-code line in CLAUDE.md is an incomplete list of what can drift. Corollary: make gate is the thing that actually caught it, which is another reason not to treat a green rebaseline as evidence the tree is clean.
